sobre.h1: K-Pop and K-Drama quiz: test your knowledge
sobre.p1: The HallyuHub quiz gathers questions on K-pop groups, the most-watched K-dramas, Korean food, language and history. It is a quick way to find out how much you know about the Korean wave and to learn something new with every answer: after each question a short explanation appears.
sobre.p2: The K-Pop theme asks about groups, idols and songs, and K-Drama about series, casts and classics. The culture and history themes cover food, language, festivals and Korea from Joseon to today. Prefer variety? "Mixed bag" mode draws questions from every theme.
sobre.h3: Frequently asked questions about the quiz

gratis.r: Yes. The HallyuHub game is free and needs no sign-up: just pick a theme and a level and play.

quantas.p: How many questions are in a round?
quantas.r: Each round has 15 questions drawn at random from the English question bank, on K-pop, K-drama, Korean culture and history. There is also a new question every day.

pontos.r: Each correct answer earns points, and answering faster earns a time bonus. Three correct answers in a row earn a streak bonus. The Beginner, Intermediate and Expert levels change the time per question and the points ceiling.

salvo.r: If you allow cookies, your score, stats and daily streak are kept in this browser. Without permission the quiz works the same; it just won't remember you on your next visit.
